integrity: The proof covers real r>1, 0<delta<r analytically. Exact-rational finite examples support, but do not replace, the proof.
scientific_limitations: Local asymptotic stability of the positive equilibrium and its exact linearized spectral gap only; no claim of global attraction, all-kernel robustness, or finite-population stochastic persistence.
title: Exact monotone recovery gap for antagonistic habitats in a two-species metacommunity
